_about: Endpoints that have no caller in the frontend tree ON PURPOSE, each with who calls it. Read by tools/endpoint_callers.py (owner rule R45, 2026-09-13: an endpoint needs a caller). An entry that gains a frontend caller is reported as NAMED-BUT-CALLED and should be removed from here. Never add an entry to make the check pass: delete the endpoint or wire it instead.
auth/connect-discord/callback/: OAuth callback: Discord sends the browser here, no frontend code builds the address
auth/discord/sso/callback/: OAuth callback: Discord sign-in returns here
auth/vent/sso/callback/: OAuth callback: v-ent.co sign-in returns here
events/capture/config/: the desktop live-capture agent (FreeFire MatchResult log watcher), not the website
events/live/push/: the desktop live-capture agent pushes match results here
sso/brand/: AFC as an SSO provider: relying parties (v-ent.co) fetch the brand kit
sso/logout/: AFC as an SSO provider: relying parties send the browser here on sign-out
whatsapp/webhook/: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API webhook (account recovery codes)
